s: nominative/accusative neuter singular of der: who, that, which
Ich kenne ein Mädchen, das das kann.
I know a girl who can do that.
Gib mir mal das Buch, das da liegt.
Please give me the book that's lying there.
nominative/accusative neuter singular of der: this, that, it
nominative/accusative neuter singular of der: it (subject of an impersonal verb)
Wissen Sie, wie spät das ist?
Do you know what time it is?
das.et: From Middle High German daȥ, from Old High German daȥ, from Proto-Germanic *þat. Compare Silesian East Central German doas, Dutch dat, English that. Doublet of dass. Distinction from dass is purely orthographical convention.

s: Ich habe gehört, dass du krank bist.

It's nice that you're with me.
Beeil dich, dass wir bald losfahren können.
Hurry up so that we can take off soon.
dass.et: From Middle High German daȥ, from Old High German daȥ, from Proto-Germanic *þat. Compare Dutch dat, Low German dat, datt, English that. Doublet of das. Distinction from das is purely orthographical convention.
